name: decipher
description: Voice-driven codebase explainer for VS Code, like a senior dev talking through it.

decipher.llmProvider.markdownDescription: LLM provider for generating explanations. Supported: `anthropic`. Add the matching API below.

decipher.llmApiKey.description: API key for the selected LLM provider. Required.

decipher.llmModel.markdownDescription: Model ID for the selected LLM provider. Anthropics defaults: `claude-sonnet-5` (balanced), `claude-opus-5` (thorough), `claude-haiku-4-5-20251001` (fastest) . See all at [platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview).

decipher.llmMaxTokens.description: Maximum tokens the LLM can use per explanation. Higher = more detailed but slower and vice-versa.

decipher.sttProvider.markdownDescription: Speech-to-text provider for voice input. Supported: `openai`.

decipher.sttApiKey.description: API key for selected speech-to-text provider. Required for voice input.

decipher.sttModel.markdownDescription: Model ID for the selected STT provider. e.g. `whisper-1` (OpenAI). Check your provider's docs for available models.

decipher.sttLanguage.description: Language hint for transcription (ISO-639-1 code, e.g. 'en', 'fr', 'de').

enumDescriptions: Type questions using the input box.
Ask questions using the microphone, transcribed by the STT provider
decipher.inputMode.description: How you want to input questions to Decipher.

decipher.ttsProvider.markdownDescription: Text-to-speech provider for voice input. Supported: `elevenlabs`

decipher.ttsApiKey.description: API key for the selected TTS provider. Required - Decipher always speaks its explanations.

decipher.ttsModel.markdownDescription: Model ID for the selected TTS provider. e.g. `eleven_turbo_v2_5` (ElevenLabs). Check your provider's docs for available models.

decipher.ttsVoiceId.description: Voice ID for the selected TTS provider. Default is ElevenLabs 'Rachel' - calm and clear, well-suited for technical narration. Browse ElevenLabs voices at elevenlabs.io/voice-library.

decipher.ttsStability.description: Voice stability (0-1). Lower = more expressive and varied. Higher = more consistent. Behavior varies by provider.

decipher.ttsSimilarityBoost.description: Similarity boost (0-1). Higher = closer to the original voice profile. Behavior varies by provider.

decipher.highlightEnabled.description: Highlight relevant code lines in the editor while Decipher explains them.

decipher.highlightColor.description: Background color for code highlights during explanation (CSS rgba value).

enumDescriptions: Voice output only, with transcript in the Decipher panel.
Voice output plus a VS Code notification with the explanation summary.
Show both the panel and a notification.
decipher.outputChannel.description: Where Decipher displays its text explanations alongside voice output.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
